description: General utility functions and classes for timing, performance logging, and common operations.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A timer for measuring and logging elapsed time for tasks.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the timer. Used as an identifier when logging.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stop the timer and return elapsed wall time.

methods.name: elapsed
methods.description: Return elapsed wall time in seconds.

functions.name: list_timings
functions.description: Print a summary of timings collected using Timer.

params.name: reduction
params.description: Reduction type to apply over ranks (min, max, average).

functions.name: timing
functions.description: Return timing data for a named task.
